mcc_row_note: The MCC row renders because MerchantCategoryCode is present. On the transaction_credit fixture (salary, MCC null) the row must be ABSENT, not blank — an absent field is not an empty one (TC-TXNDTL-002).
empty_vs_error: empty (HTTP 200, id not in result set) renders receipt_long + 'Transaction not found' + Go back and NO Retry; error renders error_outline + Retry and NO Go back. Each asserts the other component is not rendered, which is what keeps the two from collapsing (TC-TXNDTL-004 / TC-TXNDTL-010).
dates_note: Booking and value date are rendered as separate rows even though they are identical on this fixture — the pending fixture is where they diverge, and having both pinned on a settled transaction is what makes that divergence visible.
